'''Baajik''' was a [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a double agent to both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] he was killed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cypher Bos]].
